en.title: Version 1.1.1
en.content:
**Belpex and dynamic comparison**
- Prioritize the contract RLP profile for monthly variable pricing. Explicitly flag estimates using actual load or a plain average when the profile is unavailable, including across multiple months.
- Simulate monthly contracts at 15-minute consumption prices, with the existing hourly fallback when measurements or prices are insufficient. Keep each tariff grid’s coefficient, margin, VAT, distribution, taxes and injection parameters. Preserve actual dynamic resolutions, hourly fixed-tariff simulations and contract-based bill reconciliation.
- Connect the dashboard and both electricity cost API actions to the comparison methods. Mark monthly-contract comparisons as simulations even when unavailable.
- Name monthly variable energy explicitly, keep cost details readable on mobile and display monthly RLP weighting, estimated fallbacks and provisional months beside the variable cost; display the comparison resolution and hourly fallback reason separately. Keep monthly weighting and provisional-price notes visible even when the energy amount and unit rate are zero.

**Translations, documentation and tests**
- Correct French, English, German and Dutch explanations of RLP priority and estimated weighting.
- Update calculation documentation and the API contract.
- Add regressions for RLP priority, manual comparison amounts, resolution fallbacks, multiple grids and months, unavailable prices, disabled dynamic pricing, current and historical months, API responses and dashboard rendering, including zero-energy months in all four languages.
